title: Gold Eagle Submission CSAF Extension Schema for Document level metadata
description: Schema extension document to explain the metadata, fields, and types that are used as an API intake form as part of a complete CSAF 2.1 document, using the "csaf_vulnerability_report" CSAF profile.

$schema.title: CSAF extension schema
$schema.description: Immutable identity of this Gold Eagle document extension.

category.title: Extension category
category.description: Gold Eagle requires this document extension for product scopes while CSAF treats it as supplementary.

critical.title: Critical flag
critical.description: Gold Eagle enforces this extension independently of CSAF criticality.

content.title: Gold Eagle document metadata
content.description: GE document metadata including product scope for each affected product, explicit full-product-name identity, and optional business metadata.

product_scopes.title: Affected product scopes
product_scopes.description: All applicable GE environment classifications for each known-affected CSAF product ID.

product_identities.title: Identities for affected full_product_names
product_identities.description: Required by Gold Eagle for each affected full_product_names product without a vendor/product/version branch path. Values are reporter assertions, not inferred from a display name or PURL.

company_headquarters.title: Company headquarters
company_headquarters.description: Headquarters country of the affected vendor when known.

countries_deployed.title: Countries deployed
countries_deployed.description: Countries where the affected product is deployed when known.
